effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Examon] in its text and 1 such Option card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and any of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand.
